title: Anthropic picks Fluidstack for $50B US data center build

sources.quote: San Francisco, CA | Wednesday 12th November 2025 | 07:00 Fluidstack is announcing a $50 billion American computing infrastructure deal with Anthropic, building data centers in New York and Texas, with more sites to come.
We selected Fluidstack as our partner for its ability to move with exceptional agility, enabling rapid delivery of gigawatts of power.

explain: Anthropic announced a $50 billion investment in US computing infrastructure and chose Fluidstack to build and run custom data centers in Texas and New York. The $50 billion is a multi-year headline total, and not all of it will necessarily be paid to Fluidstack.
